canonical.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cuines 33, Knokke

parent.title: A weekend in Knokke, anchored on Cuines 33

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cuines 33
siblings.summary: Nine character properties within a 17-minute taxi of Knokke's newly two-starred Cuines 33 — Anglo-Norman villas, a 1930s grand hotel reborn under Glenn Sestig, and Piet Boon-designed dune retreats across the Dutch border.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cuines 33
siblings.summary: Bruges is the obvious heavyweight; the Zwin, Het Zoute, Damme, Sluis and Cadzand-Bad each earn a half-day for their own reason.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Cuines 33
siblings.summary: Inside the 30 km circle, the IT scene runs through Bruges (Howest + EUSIPCO 2026) and Oostende. Knokke-Heist itself hosts no IT conferences.
